text:
lucy: heads up, running the docker quickstart sample and my first API call fails with `402 Payment Required`. i'm using a CI service account token we created for tests.

lucy: docker run command: ```bash
docker run --rm -e RW_KEY=SA-CI-123 redwood/quickstart:latest node example.js
```

lucy: error printed by sample: `Request failed: 402 payment_required {"error":"payment_required","message":"Workspace billing not active"}`

devon_devex: thanks. quick things to check: 1) which workspace did you invite the CI SA into? 2) did that workspace accept billing (even for trials)? 3) is the SA token from the same org as the workspace?

lucy: SA belongs to org-ci-55 and the repo webhook created workspace org-ci-55-invite last week. I thought the billing trial was automatic for CI workspaces.

devon_devex: invite-created workspaces often require the billing handshake to provision trial credits. Also note we block requests from SA tokens that aren't yet mapped to the workspace tenant until billing is active.

lucy: i can't access the console from CI. is there a way to trigger refresh from the CLI or via bot?

billing-bot: to refresh tenant cache: `@billing-bot refresh <org_id>` or call `POST /internal/workspaces/<org_id>/refresh` (requires maint token).

lucy: ok ran `@billing-bot refresh org-ci-55-invite` from slack. billing-bot confirmed queued. regenerated the CI token and retried after ~1min. still 402.

devon_devex: two more edge things: 1) your regenerated token must be created inside the same org (not the personal dev org). 2) CI runners sometimes cache old envs; confirm the container actually picked up the new RW_KEY (docker inspect env or print process.env in example.js).

lucy: added a quick log to example.js to dump process.env.RW_KEY. it was still the old value inside the container (dang). updated the pipeline to inject new secret and retried.

ci-bot: pipeline run #482: deployed container with updated env (RW_KEY updated).

lucy: now response is `HTTP/1.1 200 OK` and sample logs "ok - generated: hi from docker". first successful call from CI SA. :tada:

devon_devex: sweet. small followups for docs: 1) add a CI quickstart note about env propagation and token regeneration for invite workspaces, 2) document `@billing-bot refresh` flow and expected propagation window (~30-60s), 3) mention SDK may return 403/402 depending on which layer handled the request.

lucy: agreed. also suggest a tiny console toggle for "provision trial credits for invite orgs" to avoid manual refresh. filing an internal request.

devon_devex: noted and added the doc TODO.
